48986.note: Two-story yellow oyster house in Historic St. Andrews across from the marina, buying oysters with its own trucks from the Gulf states and Virginia plus some from Alligator Harbor and Panacea.
48986.fn: Destination Panama City (2025) says it has been open more than 55 years; no reliable source pinned the year at this address.

49218.note: Thomas Drive oyster bar near Capt. Anderson's Marina that steams rather than boils its crab and shellfish.

49435.note: Front Beach Road oyster pub serving raw and baked oysters in several styles plus an oyster po' boy.
49435.fn: The pub's own site says "Since 1967"; whether it has been at this address the whole time was not confirmed.

49443.note: West-end Panama City Beach oyster bar focused on raw and chargrilled Gulf oysters, open daily.
